changes.background: Mr. Prithvi Vachani is currently serving as the Vice President at Dixon Technologies (India) Limited. He has previously demonstrated strategic acumen by orchestrating collaborations with boAt and driving the growth of Dixon's IT hardware and mobile divisions.
changes.education: Bentley University (2017 graduate), Master of Business Administration from London Business School
previous_roles: Vice President at Dixon Technologies (India) Limited

headline: Dixon Technologies appoints Prithvi Vachani as Executive Director
